title: PRIMFLOW: Learning Trajectory Primitives for Few-Step Distillation
title_zh: PRIMFLOW：学习用于少步蒸馏的轨迹基元

paragraphs.en: PRIMFLOW通过学习连续轨迹基元实现少步蒸馏，在文本到图像生成中单步推理即可取得优于基线的T-FID和HPSv2表现。 Few-step trajectory distillation aims to learn accurate global updates from dense local supervision along a teacher's sampling trajectory. Existing approaches construct within-step dynamics using specific trajectory parameterizations or discrete interval predictions, tying the learned update to a prescribed temporal structure. We propose \method, which directly learns a continuous trajectory primitive representing cumulative displacement along the teacher trajectory. By supervising finite differences of the primitive with local teacher velocities, \method learns the accumulated motion directly, while obtaining global updates through endpoint differences. This formulation avoids prescribing a temporal basis or fixed query grid and instead learns the temporal evolution of cumulative displacement from local supervision. We further establish a local-to-global error bound to characterize how local regression errors affect full-interval displacement accuracy, and introduce endpoint absorption to eliminate the auxiliary primitive branch while preserving one-network-evaluation inference. Experiments on large-scale text-to-image generation show that \method achieves a T-FID of 20.92 and an HPSv2 score of 28.35 at one NFE, improving both metrics over a trajectory-distillation baseline. After endpoint absorption, it retains comparable performance, achieving a T-FID of 20.86 and an HPSv2 score of 28.33.
paragraphs.zh: PRIMFLOW通过学习连续轨迹基元实现少步蒸馏，在文本到图像生成中单步推理即可取得优于基线的T-FID和HPSv2表现。少步轨迹蒸馏旨在从教师采样轨迹上的稠密局部监督中学习准确的全局更新。 现有方法通过特定的轨迹参数化或离散区间预测来构建步内动力学，使学习到的更新依赖于预先规定的时间结构。 我们提出\method，它直接学习一个连续轨迹基元，用以表示沿教师轨迹的累积位移。 通过用教师的局部速度对基元的有限差分进行监督，\method直接学习累积运动，同时通过端点差分获得全局更新。 这一构造无需规定时间基或固定查询网格，而是从局部监督中学习累积位移的时间演化。 我们进一步建立了局部到全局的误差界，以刻画局部回归误差如何影响全区间位移精度，并引入端点吸收，在保持单次网络评估推理的同时消除辅助的基元分支。 在大规模文本到图像生成实验中，\method在单次网络评估（NFE）下取得20.92的T-FID和28.35的HPSv2分数，两项指标均优于轨迹蒸馏基线。 经端点吸收后，其性能仍保持相当水平，取得20.86的T-FID和28.33的HPSv2分数。
